The '''''Cinzia''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] built on [[Sebaddon]] around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. It had been sent by [[Lema Xandret]] to establish a peace treaty. Some years after the [[Treaty of Coruscant]], the ''Cinzia'' was confronted by the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Jet Nebula]] in the ''[[Auriga Fire]]'', but the starship, controlled by [[Fastbreeder]]s, [[Self-destruct mechanism/Legends|self-destructed]]. Nebula was able to recover the ship's [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computer]], as well as a compact fastbreeder factory that produced the deadly [[Droid/Legends|droids]].
